notes:
**A dragged stop landed at a different price from the one under your finger.** Once you pan back into history with a live price outside the visible range, the touch layer and the drawing layer were building the price scale from different inputs - so a target or stop dropped on the chart was placed somewhere else.

**The option chain's "computed" marker was on the wrong column.** The ~ that tells you a greek came from the app's own model rather than your broker was only ever drawn on IV. A model delta was shown bare; a broker IV next to a model delta was stamped as computed. And the sheet you get by tapping a row printed "0.00" for a greek the row itself correctly showed as a dash - a quote at or below intrinsic has no readable volatility, and that is an ordinary thing, not a zero.

**Ten code comments described an app this one used to be** - four still quoting the flat 0.35% cost model that was replaced months ago, one claiming a test pinned two functions together when no such test exists, and two on the trust page: the cloud backup does not go to "your own Google account", it goes to a Firebase database this app owns, filed under the account you signed in with.
